chunks: He said: "O my Lord, my bones have weakened, and my head has caught fire with white hair, and I was not deprived of Your call, O Lord."
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Jacob say about his aging and his prayers to God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Maryam is often cited to illustrate the spiritual resilience of the Prophets, where physical decline does not diminish the efficacy of their devotion. It underscores the concept that divine favor is not contingent upon bodily strength, but rather on the constancy of the servant's plea, a theme central to the Imams' teachings on patience during affliction.
